notices.title: Outdoor Activities Restricted Today
notices.body:
Due to **Unhealthy** air quality (AQI 156), all outdoor activities including PE, recess, and sports practice have been moved indoors or cancelled. Please ensure your child carries indoor activity supplies.

The school will monitor conditions throughout the day and update if the situation changes.

notices.title: Afternoon Improvement Expected
notices.body: Forecast indicates AQI may improve to **Moderate** (~95) by 16:00. Dismissal will proceed normally outdoors. Brief outdoor exposure is safe.
